devdoc.title: Filtered Minter contract that allows tokens to be minted with ETH. Pricing is achieved using an automated Dutch-auction mechanism.

AuctionHalfLifeRangeSecondsUpdated(uint2.notice: Maximum and minimum allowed price decay half lifes updated.

PricePerTokenInWeiUpdated(uint256,uint25.notice: Price per token in wei updated for project `_projectId` to `_pricePerTokenInWei`.

ProjectCurrencyInfoUpdated(uint256,addre.notice: Currency updated for project `_projectId` to symbol `_currencySymbol` and address `_currencyAddress`.

constructor.notice: Initializes contract to be a Filtered Minter for `_minterFilter`, integrated with Art Blocks core contract at address `_genArt721Address`.

contractMintable(uint256).notice: projectId => are contracts allowed to mint?

genArt721CoreAddress().notice: Core contract address this minter interacts with

getPriceInfo(uint256).notice: Gets if price of token is configured, price of minting a token on project `_projectId`, and currency symbol and address to be used as payment. Supersedes any core contract price information.

maximumPriceDecayHalfLifeSeconds().notice: Maximum price decay half life: price may decay with a half life of no more than this amount (may cut in half at no more than every N seconds).

minimumPriceDecayHalfLifeSeconds().notice: Minimum price decay half life: price must decay with a half life of at least this amount (must cut in half at least every N seconds).

minterFilterAddress().notice: Minter filter address this minter interacts with

projectMaxHasBeenInvoked(uint256).notice: projectId => has project reached its maximum number of invocations?

projectMaxInvocations(uint256).notice: projectId => project's maximum number of invocations

projectMintCounter(address,uint256).notice: purchaser address => projectId => number of mints purchased

projectMintLimit(uint256).notice: projectId => maximum number of mints a given address may invoke

purchaseTo(address,uint256).notice: Purchases a token from project `_projectId` and sets the token's owner to `_to`.

purchaseToDisabled(uint256).notice: projectId => are tokens allowed to be minted to other addresses?

resetAuctionDetails(uint256).notice: Resets auction details for project `_projectId`, zero-ing out all relevant auction fields. Not intended to be used in normal auction operation, but rather only in case of the need to halt an auction.

setAllowablePriceDecayHalfLifeRangeSecon.notice: Sets the minimum and maximum values that are settable for `_priceDecayHalfLifeSeconds` across all projects.

setProjectMaxInvocations(uint256).notice: Sets the maximum invocations of project `_projectId` based on the value currently defined in the core contract.

setProjectMintLimit(uint256,uint8).notice: Sets the mint limit of a single purchaser for project `_projectId` to `_limit`.

toggleContractMintable(uint256).notice: Toggles if contracts are allowed to mint tokens for project `_projectId`.

togglePurchaseToDisabled(uint256).notice: Toggles if purchases to other address are enabled for project `_projectId`.
